tasks.label: Deploy to Piave Staging
tasks.command: npm run build && rsync -avz --exclude 'node_modules' --exclude '.git' --exclude '.env' --exclude '.env.*' --exclude 'dist' --exclude 'docs' --exclude 'scripts' --exclude 'deploy' --exclude '.vscode' --exclude '.opencode' --exclude '*.md' --exclude '.DS_Store' ./ piave:~/stage-platform/apps/stage-condominio-app/src/ && ssh piave '~/stage-platform/bin/stage-cli deploy stage-condominio-app'
